title_candidates: Gemini 3.7 Flash arrives with faster, cheaper agent work
summary: Google released Gemini 3.7 Flash for stronger coding, document, and agent workflows, with immediate browser access through Google AI Studio.

primary_source.title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
primary_source.author: Google
key_facts: Gemini 3.7 Flash was released three weeks after Gemini 3.6 Flash.
Google reports improvements in coding, web development, document analysis, and multi-step agent workflows.
The model is available in Google AI Studio, the Gemini API, Antigravity, Android Studio, enterprise products, and Gemini Spark.
Gemini Spark uses 3.7 Flash for eligible Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers in supported countries.
Introductory API pricing is $0.75 per million input tokens and $3.75 per million output tokens through December 31, 2026.

supporting_sources.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash model card
key_facts: The model accepts text, images, audio, and video with up to a one-million-token input context.
The model card lists hallucinations, occasional slowness, and timeouts among known limitations.

steps.instruction: Select Gemini 3.7 Flash in Google AI Studio and test it on a short source with known facts and a deliberate contradiction.
Compare every summary claim with the source and avoid uploading confidential material until the tool's terms and organizational rules are understood.

risk_flags: Provider benchmarks must be identified as provider-reported rather than independent proof.
The test uses non-sensitive text and does not assume Gemini app or Spark availability for every account or country.
